teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: invite, party, dinner, weekend, birthday, celebration, come, accept, refuse, sorry, busy, free

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
invite, party, dinner, weekend, birthday, celebration, come, accept, refuse, sorry, busy, free
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Would you like to come to my party? (extending invitation)
• I'd love to, thank you! (accepting enthusiastically)
• I'm sorry, I am busy this weekend (refusing politely)
• Let's meet at seven (agreeing time & place)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Polite intonation contours on 'I'm sorry', 'I'd love to'. Linking in 'Would you like'.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Modals for Invitation & Preference ('Would you like to...?', 'I would love to', 'I'm sorry, I can't')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Modals for Invitation & Preference ('Would you like to...?', 'I would love to', 'I'm sorry, I can't')
Controlled Practice:
Your friend invites you to dinner, but you cannot go. What do you say?
options: I'm sorry, I can't. I'm busy.
answers: I'm sorry, I can't. I'm busy.

elements.content: Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
B: I'd love to! What time does it start?
A: At seven in the evening.
C: Oh, I'm sorry, I am busy this Saturday.
Listen to three telephone invitations and determine whether each person accepts or refuses.
